_about: SMOKE SET, synthetic. Written by Claude on 2026-11-27 against the placeholder corpus in data/pyqs.json. Queries are reworded on purpose so they do not copy the corpus text. 'target' is the corpus question (without the '(Variation N)' suffix) that answers the query; null means the corpus cannot answer it and retrieval should return nothing. Good only for before/after comparisons of retrieval code, NOT for quality claims. Replace with a hand-labelled set once the real corpus exists (README problem 3).
